items.name: calibration-desk
items.title: Calibration desk
items.description: The whole arc on one screen, as a worked example: gauges due for calibration (status strip and data table), a reminder rule, a two-role approval, a confirm-then-send to owners, and an audit timeline of every decision, send and failure. Runs on an in-memory server you replace with real calls.
items.docs:
The whole arc on one screen: a table of gauges due, a rule, a two-role approval, a confirm-then-send and an audit timeline, on an in-memory server.
Read the installed file before using it; use only the props it exports.
Replace createMemoryServer() with real calls in one place: pass your own server prop. Your server must check the user and role, write the audit events and enforce quiet hours.
Docs: https://regularui.com/docs/components/calibration-desk.md
Verify: run your typechecker.

items.name: quiz
items.title: Quiz
items.description: Tap an answer and see at once whether it was right, and which option was. One attempt per question, then it locks; the footer shows the score and Try again.
items.docs:
A set of questions answered by tapping: instant right or wrong, the right option revealed, one attempt each, then a score and Try again. Also exports QuizCard for a single controlled question.
Read the installed file before using it; use only the props it exports.
The wording ("Correct", "Not quite. The answer is B.", "N of M correct", "Try again") is fixed; copy the file to change it. No persistence, timer or shuffling.
Docs: https://regularui.com/docs/components/quiz.md
Verify: run your typechecker.
